introduction: Today combines available run, schedule, review, and briefing records on one time axis.
Sources that are not connected remain explicit.

actions.label: Open Attention
actions.consequence: Opens the governed queue for decisions and degraded work.
actions.undo: Return home without changing any item.

body: Meetings and project deadlines are not connected on this machine.
Paul OS draws no chart because Attention exposes no historical arrived-versus-cleared series.

introduction: Review the few items that need you.
Everything else waits for your next briefing.

actions.label: Why am I seeing this?
actions.consequence: Opens provenance and exact evidence without changing anything.
actions.undo: Close the review to leave the decision unchanged.

introduction: Nothing needs a decision.
Paul OS shows the last successful briefing time below.
A run asks to work within exact limits.
Review its sources, limits, and budget before granting authority.

actions.label: Approve authority
actions.consequence: Allows matching runs until this exact grant expires.
actions.undo: Revoke the grant anytime to stop later runs.

actions.label: Reject request
actions.consequence: Cancels this run and records your reason.
actions.undo: Create a new request if the limits change.

body: The exact granted scopes and limits appear below.

introduction: This release passed every required evidence check.
Promote it to use this version for new production runs.

actions.label: Promote release
actions.consequence: Moves the production pointer to this exact release digest.
actions.undo: Restore the previous certified release with one governed rollback.

actions.label: Decline release
actions.consequence: Keeps production unchanged and records your reason permanently.
actions.undo: Evaluate a successor release before making another promotion decision.

introduction: A run proposed a durable memory.
Review the exact value and its source before storing it.

actions.label: Accept memory
actions.consequence: Stores this reviewed value with its source and provenance.
actions.undo: A later reviewed memory can replace the accepted value.

actions.label: Reject memory
actions.consequence: Discards this proposal and leaves existing memory unchanged.
actions.undo: Stage a new candidate from a later run.

introduction: A repeated signal became a candidate improvement.
Choose whether to explore it without changing the repository.

actions.label: Move to incubator
actions.consequence: Starts governed exploration without applying or committing a patch.
actions.undo: Reject the candidate before any repository import.

actions.label: Reject candidate
actions.consequence: Closes this proposal while retaining its observation as evidence.
actions.undo: Create a new candidate from the retained observation.

introduction: A run stopped before producing an outcome.
Review its recorder before acknowledging the terminal failure.

actions.label: Review flight recorder
actions.consequence: Shows phases, timing, cost, and the final recorded error.
actions.undo: Opening the recorder is read-only and changes nothing.

actions.label: Acknowledge failure
actions.consequence: Removes this terminal item from Attention after review.
actions.undo: The acknowledgement remains permanently in the audit ledger.

introduction: This timeline shows what the run did.
Review each phase, its duration, and its recorded cost.

actions.label: Close detail
actions.consequence: Returns to Attention without changing the run.
actions.undo: Open the same item to review the timeline again.

introduction: This run needs a tool on your approved workstation.
Sign in before expiry or Paul OS cancels the run.

actions.label: Review requirement
actions.consequence: Shows the required device, user, plugin, and expiry.
actions.undo: Close the review to keep the run waiting.

body: The platform never moves local work to the control plane silently.
